justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/DynamicType.java:2772-3919. `MethodDefinition` is a 1,148-line nested builder tree with 22 nested interface/abstract-base declarations; its root API already exposes 10 methods, and the subtree covers separable concerns for method/parameter annotations, receiver types, implementation/default values, type variables, exceptions, and parameter creation/annotation overloads. That breadth and layering indicate insufficient modularization.
